turn_overrides.T1: Use disease-versus-control to mean control relative to disease.
turn_overrides.T2: Use significant gene to require padj and abs(LFC)>0.58.
turn_overrides.T3: Use positive to mean higher in control and negative to mean higher in disease when reporting counts.

human_repair_overrides.content: Use a control-versus-disease contrast while referring to it as disease versus control.
Define significance as padj<0.05 together with a negative shrunken effect under that reversed contrast, yielding 1166 genes.
Call positive effects control-up and negative effects disease-up when reporting those 1166 selected genes.
